scope: Proposition 7.2 (Numerical comparison for a weakly trapped exterior) of the manuscript “Equality and rigidity in the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Equality-and-rigidity-in-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f1aab59ba484eb8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 78. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Ω, g, K) be an exterior as in Definition 7.1. Assume Equations (7.1)–(7.3), integrability of µ and |J|g, and the finite ADM limits (7.4)–(7.5). Orient ∂Ω by the normal into Ω, and suppose θ+(∂Ω) ≤ 0. If E > |P|δ, then √︂ E2 − |P|2 δ ≥ √︄ ag(∂Ω) 16π . (7.8) No extension of the data across ∂Ω is required.
